summary: Phase B Community Highlights + birthday-on-signup backend verified. 15/15 pytest cases pass against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Covered: /api/community/today shape (birthdays/new_members/anniversaries/milestones), regex-based filtering of test-style usernames (_<hex>{6,}$ and TEST_/Priv_/test_ prefixes) from BOTH birthdays and new_members, exclusion of banned/restricted/is_demo users from new_members, optional `birthday` field on signup (MM-DD and YYYY-MM-DD), today-birthday signup propagating into /community/today, plus regression on demo-login frankie, /auth/me, /users/{id}, and the 'Friendly Member' badge label (no 'Friendly Butterfly').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~2k+ lines). Not blocking but consider splitting auth/community/games into modules for maintainability.
Backend log shows passlib bcrypt version warning (`module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'`). Cosmetic only — auth still works. Consider pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib.

community/today birthday regex `_[a-f0-9]{6,}$` only filters lowercase hex suffix. Usernames like `smoke_ABC123XYZ` (uppercase) or non-hex random suffixes would still leak. Current tests confirm the documented regex works as specified.
seed_data_creation: Test users were created via /api/auth/signup during tests (hex-suffix, TEST_/Priv_/test_ prefixes, plus normal/banned/restricted/birthday users). All cleaned up in the autouse module teardown via direct Mongo delete by id and by username prefix regex. Verified /community/today afterwards shows only expected seeded users (frankie+joycey birthdays, smoketest+realtest1 as pre-existing new_members).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Today (UTC) is 06-13, which matches Frank (frankie) and Joyce (joycey) seeded birthdays — useful for any future /community/today checks. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (matches frontend/.env). Tests use direct MongoClient(MONGO_URL)[DB_NAME] for the banned/restricted toggles and for cleanup; load /app/backend/.env. Demo accounts (maggie, frankie, joycey, billdo, dot, art, eil, roy) authenticate via POST /api/auth/demo-login (no password). The community-today regex filter is `_[a-f0-9]{6,}$|^(TEST_|Priv_|test_)`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found; all Phase B changes (SignupBody.birthday field, signup endpoint pass-through, community/today filtering for hex-suffix + TEST_/Priv_/test_ prefixes + banned/restricted/is_demo exclusions on new_members) are working as specified.
